The color scheme is monochromatic, with the boat's body painted in a pristine white that contrasts beautifully with the deep blue of the ocean. The perspective of the image is from above, looking down at the boat as it navigates the choppy waters. The sky above is a clear blue, devoid of any clouds, suggesting a bright, sunny day. The overall composition of the image is dynamic and visually striking, highlighting the speed and power of the speedboat against the vast expanse of the sea.
